verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's docs say users can download the OpenAPI ("Swagger") schema alongside a Postman collection. A hands-on probe confirmed this: an unauthenticated GET to /openapi/mesh-api.json returned a parseable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec covering customer, case, audit, export and transaction resources. The 404s at conventional guessed paths reflect only discoverability, not a contradiction. missing for 10: spec not discoverable at standard well-known paths (e.g. /openapi.json or /.well-known/openapi.json), only a brief first-party doc mention of the download.
